title: bot.ability.classifying.output
description: The tone heard in a voice: an affect label, the classifier's score per affect class, valence from negative to positive, and the classifier's confidence in the label (mosfet.py's voice.Affect).

id.description: The requester's id, echoed when the answer is the long-lived classifier's reply to a request [floppy field].
id.title: Id

label.description: The affect class the voice sounded most like, as the classifier names it.
label.title: Label

scores.description: The classifier's score from 0 to 1 for each affect class it knows; empty when it gives none.
scores.title: Scores

valence.description: How positive the voice sounded, from -1 (negative) to 1 (positive), when the classifier says.
valence.title: Valence

confidence.description: The classifier's confidence in the label, from 0 to 1, when it says.
confidence.title: Confidence
